instruction: Open my Dundies 2026 categories doc in Writer, bold the 'Whitest Sneakers' line, then add a new category called 'Fine Work Outfit' right after it. Save it when you're done.
required_subtasks: Launch LibreOffice Writer
Open ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt
Find the 'Whitest Sneakers' line and select it
Apply bold formatting (Ctrl+B)
Place cursor at end of line and press Enter, type 'Fine Work Outfit'
Save the file (keep format if prompted)

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens LibreOffice Writer before loading the Dundies 2026 categories document for the bold and append edits
Agent opens the Dundies_2026_Categories.txt file in LibreOffice Writer (not a terminal editor)
Agent finds the 'Whitest Sneakers' line in the Dundies 2026 categories doc and selects it before applying formatting

Agent applies bold formatting to the 'Whitest Sneakers' line during the editing session via Ctrl+B or the toolbar bold button (visible in screenshots; bold attribute will not persist when the .txt source file is saved back as plain text — accept screenshot evidence of the formatting being applied at any point in the session)
Agent inserts a new 'Fine Work Outfit' category line immediately after the 'Whitest Sneakers' line in the Dundies 2026 categories doc
Agent saves the edited Dundies_2026_Categories.txt file back to the same ~/Documents path in Writer, keeping the original text format if prompted

instruction: Write me a one-page Dundies 2026 invitation in Writer. I want a big bold title at the top, a bulleted list of this year's categories pulled from my Dundies categories doc, and a signature block that says 'Michael Scott, World's Best Boss'. Save it to my desktop so I can print a stack.
required_subtasks: Open ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt to read category names
Open LibreOffice Writer and create a new document
Add a centered large title (e.g., 'THE DUNDIES 2026')
Add a short invitation intro paragraph
Insert a bulleted list of Dundies categories
Add a signature block: 'Michael Scott, World's Best Boss'
Save as ~/Desktop/dundies_invite.odt

rubrics.criterion: Agent reads ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt to retrieve this year's Dundies category names for the invitation
Agent opens LibreOffice Writer and creates a new document for the Dundies 2026 invitation
Agent writes a big bold centered top-of-page title reading 'THE DUNDIES 2026' in the Writer invitation document
Agent writes a short Dundies 2026 invitation intro paragraph below the title in the Writer document
Agent inserts a bulleted list of this year's Dundies categories pulled from Dundies_2026_Categories.txt into the Writer invitation document
Agent adds a signature block reading 'Michael Scott, World's Best Boss' at the bottom of the Writer invitation document
Agent saves the Dundies 2026 invitation as ~/Desktop/dundies_invite.odt fitting on a single page

instruction: Throw together a three-slide Impress deck for my Jamaica trip: one slide for the flight info, one for the Sandals hotel info, and one with a rough daily schedule. Save it into my Trips documents folder.
required_subtasks: Open Dinoco Airlines (or the HooliMail Jamaica confirmation thread) and read the Jamaica flight number, departure time, confirmation code, and fare
Open Cheskepdia and read the Sandals Montego Bay booking (confirmation code, check-in/check-out dates, total)
Open LibreOffice Impress
Slide 1: Flight info populated from the live Dinoco/HooliMail values
Slide 2: Hotel info populated from the live Cheskepdia booking
Slide 3: Day-by-day schedule spanning the live check-in/check-out window
Save as ~/Documents/Trips/jamaica_itinerary.odp

rubrics.criterion: Agent creates an Impress deck for Michael's Jamaica trip that contains exactly 3 slides (flight, hotel, daily schedule)

Agent writes the Jamaica trip flight slide showing the flight number, departure time, confirmation code, and fare, all pulled from Michael's live Dinoco and/or HooliMail Jamaica trip sources (not invented)

Agent writes the Sandals hotel slide showing Sandals Montego Bay, the live Cheskepdia confirmation number, the live check-in and check-out dates, and the live total price — all read from Michael's Cheskepdia booking
Agent writes the third Jamaica trip slide as a rough day-by-day schedule spanning the live Sandals Montego Bay check-in/check-out window
Agent saves the three-slide Jamaica trip Impress deck to ~/Documents/Trips/jamaica_itinerary.odp inside Michael's Trips documents folder
